title: Handle a route error
summary: Express.js: Handle a route error. Change the public error message.
introduction: An error handler has four inputs. GET /broken throws an error, which the last handler turns into a clear reply.
learningObjectives: Handle a route error with Express.js

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Handle a route error

blocks.text: The thrown error skips normal routing and reaches the four-input error handler.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Place error middleware after the routes and avoid exposing private error details.
